text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if there's anything good, 
anything good around~♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! Excuse me, Mr. Pigeon. Would you 
mind if I took a photo?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Aha. That cloud looks like a carrot.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: All right. What's one plus one~~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Rhein Kraft enjoyed her day off to 
her heart's content!
